locations.notes: Discord is cloud-synced — servers, DMs, and message history live server-side and return on sign-in. There is no user-authored local data worth carrying, so data is intentionally empty.
Window bounds, audio prefs, UI flags — JSON Discord writes itself. Validate it parses before reapply; auth tokens live in Local Storage blobs, not here, so this file is not a credential hole.
Chromium caches plus Local/Session Storage — this is where Discord's auth token blobs live, the #1 target of token-stealer malware. Rebuilt on sign-in; never carried across the wipe.
No fixed Linux install path (deb/rpm/flatpak vary); the client reinstalls via Chocolatey on Windows and the package manager on Linux. Never copy app binaries.
